section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the procedure for data collection in the study. Participants were offered the option of completing the study either online through FluidSurveys (a Canadian web-based service) or in traditional pen-and-paper format. The survey included an information letter outlining the voluntary nature of the study, participants' right to withdraw, and the research objectives. Participants were not compensated, and the study was approved by the university Ethics Review Board.
